title: Evaluation of Large Language Models for Summarization Tasks in the Medical Domain: A Narrative Review

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through human evaluation rubrics (under the "Bias/Harm" criteria) to assess whether the generated clinical text introduces potential harm to a patient, incorporates inaccurate/inapplicable information, or uses biased and stigmatizing language.
Evaluated in the context of "LLM-as-a-judge" frameworks, noting the need to test whether evaluating LLMs show an unfair preference or bias toward text that they generated themselves.
Discussed as a systemic risk in clinical settings, evaluated by observing the potential for healthcare professionals to overly rely on or trust generative AI outputs despite potential inaccuracies.
